title: GC/MS analysis & biological activities of mulberry leaf extract and formulation of instant freeze-dried functional beverage following encapsulation in protei-rich skim milk powder.

This study examines the volatile constituents and bioactive potential of mulberry leaf extract (MLE). Gas chromatography-mass spectrometry (GC-MS) identified key compounds such as gibberellic acid, 9,12,15-octadecatrienoic acid, and 5,7-dihydroxy isoflavone...
